legal_history.finding: Reference to 2016 Nutraceutical Regulations; alone not sufficient for later operating directions.
Operationalised draft Nutra Regulations 2022 and states supersession of 2016; Annexure 1 lists Schedules I to IV, Schedule IV pre/probiotics, Annexure 3 additives.
Re-operationalised 2022 provisions; permits Codex additives and GMP table across covered formats/categories pending final notification, without class-wide approval of every substance.
Re-operationalises provisions identified in the 5 June direction with effect from 1 July 2024; not itself proof of an October 2026 final Gazette status.

verified_regulatory_principles.assertion: 2022 Annexure 1 Schedules I nutrient, II botanical, III molecule/extract and IV prebiotic/probiotic; older VI/VIII must not auto-map.
Premix is two or more schedule ingredients in defined proportions for covered formulation, not a blanket approval.
Specific Annexure 3/Appendix A usage and purity references must be matched before applying an additive permission.
June 2024 direction permits Codex additives and GMP table subject to the direction; this is not an unlimited use or contaminant limit.
FSSAI FPIVS generated statement expressly is not a license or authoritative statement of law.

cases.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
cases.current_source_interpretation: FPSFA Appendix A permissions must be matched to a named INS/CAS additive, functional use, finished category, and actual commercial grade.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: Product INS/CAS and concentration absent; even a nutraceutical additive allowance cannot determine a finished-polyol CTR article.
documentary_actions: Get single polyol or blended formulation and individual INS/CAS identities
Check actual product category and Appendix A usage permission in current FPSFA compendium
Obtain batch purity profile, supplier COA, and independent CTR IX article signoff

cases.current_source_interpretation: June 2026 FSSAI non-specified-food status list has CLOSED/WITHDRAWN Sajji Khar applications; applicant status is not approval nor a universal product prohibition.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: No supplier recipe/approved final food identity; reject any auto conversion of status-register entries to licensed product.
documentary_actions: Obtain current supplier formula, alkali mineral source and INS/CAS where applicable
Seek an actual authorizing order/license specific to the real product, not a list entry
Request finished lot COA and independently applicable CTR source

cases.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.current_source_interpretation: Appendix A regulation is a food-category/INS use-level mapping, not one consolidated additive composition or contaminant limit.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: The umbrella catalogue title cannot legally identify ingredient purity, finished food article or analytically valid basis.
documentary_actions: Identify exact additive INS and vendor specification
Verify functional class, destination food category, GMP or specified maximum, and Gazette version
Keep technological usage allowance separate from contaminant and residue limit

cases.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.current_source_interpretation: 2016/2021 nutraceutical Schedule VA–VF references are legacy. The 2022 operationalised framework uses Schedules I–IV plus Annexure 3 for specified additives/excipients; cannot assume a one-to-one correspondence.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: Old VA–VF catalogue title cannot be treated as a verified applicable current schedule, additive permission, or chemical identity.
documentary_actions: Specify exact historical VA/VB/VC/VD/VE/VF row and commercial substance
Crosswalk category, ingredient/additive use and format against 2022 direction Annexures 1–3 and 2024 re-operationalisation
Review later effective notifications, if any, before concluding present permission

cases.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.current_source_interpretation: FPSFA Appendix C processing aids and the 31 Oct 2022 Gazette's Table 11A for enzymes from genetically modified microorganisms are enzyme-, producer-, donor- and use-specific.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: An enzyme class entry does not provide an enzyme EC identity, microbial source, processing aid approval, carryover basis or contaminant threshold.
documentary_actions: Obtain EC activity, enzyme chemical identity and supplier product formulation
Get producing microbe and donor organism genetic/source documents
Verify permitted processing use and residual/processing-aid classification in current Appendix C

cases.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.current_source_interpretation: Legacy 2016/2021 Schedules IV/VI/VIII are not a valid literal 2022 schedule crosswalk: 2022 Schedule IV refers to prebiotics and probiotics, and its framework lists only Schedules I–IV.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: Do not treat old VI/VIII numbers as matching new schedules or assume authorization of named or unnamed nutraceutical ingredients.
documentary_actions: Obtain every historically referenced IV/VI/VIII ingredient name and botanical part / CAS
Remap under 2022 Schedule I nutrient, II botanical, III molecules/extracts, IV pre-/probiotic
Check applicable category, extract ratio, daily usage and latest effective schedule before authorization

cases.current_source_interpretation: 2022 direction defines premix as two or more scheduled ingredients in specified proportions, with or without additives, packed for formulation of a covered product.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: A premix catalogue entry is not proof that each specific constituent or the resulting marketed finished product is permitted.
documentary_actions: Obtain complete signed quantitative bill of materials and intended use
Check each ingredient Schedule I–IV or additional applicable permission and final label/format
Obtain actual lot impurity evidence and separate exact finished-product CTR applicability

cases.current_source_interpretation: Official classical recipe identifies coconut flesh and milk. An FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara recipe reference does not by itself verify a marketed batch, shelf life, food-business license or contaminant article.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: Confirm effect of 25 July 2025 and 19 June 2026 Ayurveda recipe orders separately; neither a classical best-use note nor a taxonomy page is a finished lot PASS.
documentary_actions: Reconcile recipe 29.8 with marketed article 14.3 and current orders
Collect actual coconut/milk ratio, provenance, process, shelf-life and label
Verify commercial FoSCoS license, sample COA and exact applicable CTR article

cases.current_source_interpretation: Official classical recipe names buffalo milk, aromatic flowers, water and sugar; 'four milks' is not the published formula. Actual botanical flower identification and commercial processing remain missing.
cases.legal_article_nontransfer_reason: Check applicable Ayurveda Aahara orders (2025 and June 2026), real formula, intended format and separate licensing rather than transfer ordinary milk or dairy contaminant rows.
documentary_actions: Identify buffalo milk, allowed aromatic flower species, equal milk/water stage and sweetener dose
Validate commercial heat process, storage, shelf-life and food licensing
Select the exact final food CTR basis and batch COA independently

note: Do not infer that 2024 is necessarily the final current legal notification. Official Gazette/amendment reconciliation through actual assessment date remains required. No blanket applicability from old schedules, FPIVS, Gazette processing aid examples or Ayurveda recipes.
